heading: Everything your AV team needs.
intro: Forward this straight to facilities, AV, or the venue. The setup is small, practical, and built to fit around the event rather than take it over.
supportNote: Want the rider checked against your floor plan or run sheet first? Send me the date, venue, and schedule, and I will come back with availability and the setup notes.
documentSubtitle: Compact technical requirements for Luke Stamer corporate event performances.

items.detail: 1x standard 220V/13A outlet within roughly 3m of the performance position.
Approximately 2m x 1.5m, armless chair supplied by venue, no riser required.
I bring my own speaker, which covers rooms of roughly 100 guests or fewer. For larger rooms and outdoor spaces, please provide a PA suited to the venue and guest count.

Clip-on lavalier instrument mic, connecting to the desk by XLR or 6.35mm jack. Requires 48V phantom power. I carry a backup dynamic XLR mic — please tell me in advance if phantom power is unavailable.
Bluetooth input preferred, so I can adjust volume, song choice, and set length on the fly as the room responds. A wired run is fine whenever a sound technician is on the desk.
30-45 minutes before doors, or at the earliest quiet window your run sheet allows.
Self-managed, approximately 20 minutes each, with a discreet route preferred.
Black tie, business formal, or an agreed dress code to match your event standard.
Can slot into MC, DJ, AV, and speech cues; can play to a click or hold for live timings.
